## Appearance

Obed Abernethy is an unusual-appearing individual with an awkward frame, hunching shoulders, and warm brown eyes. He has lengthy, iron-gray hair that reaches his shoulders and has maintained a thick, gentle brown beard since the age of twenty.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER II. Obed Abernethy Is Surprised P3](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0003), [v1 CHAPTER XXXII. The Pass List Is Out P34](../source/v01-c32.md#nw-v01-c32-p0034)_

## Personality

Obed Abernethy is a quiet, reserved, and extremely shy individual who tends to be silent, bashful, and uncommunicative in social settings. He is exceptionally timid, holding a deep-seated fear of women—with the exception of [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) and Mrs. Agatha—as well as little girls. He despises being surrounded by unfamiliar people or visiting places where he might be expected to converse, often preferring to retreat into the shadows. Despite his taciturn nature, he is a gentle, patient, and good-natured listener who appreciates talkative companions. However, he is also remarkably stubborn, possessing a habit of adopting a caprice and tenaciously clinging to his view regardless of logic or reasoning.

## History

Obed Abernethy was a quiet, timid man who wore a thick brown beard and lived at [Grey Shutters](../codex/places.md#grey-shutters) with his sister, [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md). Driven by a desire for help on their farm, he set out to pick up a Nova Scotian orphan boy, only to discover an orphan girl named [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) waiting for him instead. Taking her into his buggy, he enjoyed her chatty company and brought her home. Although [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) initially intended to send [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) back to the asylum, Obed quietly wished to keep her and later persuaded [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) to apologize to a neighbor after a outburst, smoothing over her stay. Over the years, he offered the young girl gentle affection and consistent support. Noticing her poor wardrobe, he enlisted help to buy fabric and have a stylish gown made for her as a [Christmas](../codex/places.md#merry-christmas) surprise. When [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) took her entrance exams, Obed joined the family in proudly celebrating her top results. He also gave her his steady encouragement as she pursued her education, right up until her graduation. Tragically, upon learning that their savings bank had failed, Obed suffered a collapse and died, leaving [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) and [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) to mourn his loss at [Grey Shutters](../codex/places.md#grey-shutters).

## Quotes

> "Indeed, she failed to do so. The girl was brought by her. This was confirmed by my query to the stationmaster. Consequently, bringing her back fell upon me. Leaving her at that place was impossible, regardless of how the error originated."
>
> — Obed Abernethy — [v1 CHAPTER III. Thirza Abernethy Is Surprised P5](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0005)

> "Young Tobias Buote from the Creek came by earlier today, and I informed him that I thought I would take him on for the summer season."
>
> — Obed Abernethy — [v1 CHAPTER IV. Morning at Grey Shutters P43](../source/v01-c04.md#nw-v01-c04-p0043)

> "I suppose she should receive a bit of punishment. However, Thirza, refrain from being overly strict with her. Keep in mind that she has never possessed anybody to instruct her properly. You—you intend to provide her with food, do you not?"
>
> — Obed Abernethy — [v1 CHAPTER X. Nell’s Apology P3](../source/v01-c10.md#nw-v01-c10-p0003)

> "You realize it is bound to happen eventually, because Thirza possesses a terrible resolve—a terrible resolve, Nell. My advice is to perform it immediately and get it done."
>
> — Obed Abernethy — [v1 CHAPTER X. Nell’s Apology P13](../source/v01-c10.md#nw-v01-c10-p0013)

> "Indeed—you are correct, Nell. However, keep Thirza from knowing I mentioned a word regarding it. She could believe I was meddling, and I gave my word to refrain from doing so."
>
> — Obed Abernethy — [v1 CHAPTER X. Nell’s Apology P19](../source/v01-c10.md#nw-v01-c10-p0019)

## Relationships

### [Nell Harcourt](../character/nell-harcourt.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/nell-harcourt--obed-abernethy.md)

Obed serves as a guardian, parent, and beloved protector to [Nell Harcourt](../character/nell-harcourt.md) after taking her in at [Grey Shutters](../codex/places.md#grey-shutters). Though initially shocked when an orphan girl arrived instead of a boy, Obed quietly wished to keep her while his sister wanted to send her back. He offers her gentle support and treats, such as giving her chocolates and privately persuading her to apologize after an outburst with a neighbor.

### [Thirza Abernethy](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/obed-abernethy--thirza-abernethy.md)

Obed and [Thirza Abernethy](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) are siblings who live together at [Grey Shutters](../codex/places.md#grey-shutters) and co-parent [Nell Harcourt](../character/nell-harcourt.md). While [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) initially takes a strict stance on farm management and religious upbringing, Obed holds a gentler demeanor and quietly advocates for keeping [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md). Despite Thirza's initial sharp firmness compared to Obed's quiet affection, the two work together in managing their household and raising the girl.
